headline:
Worried About Your Income
After You Buy?
echo_q: Hey Titan, here's what keeps me up about buying. What happens if I lose my job, or my income changes, after I've already closed?
titan_answer: Say your hours get cut a few months after you close. I'd call the company you send your payment to right away, even before you miss one, and be ready to explain your income and expenses. A HUD-approved housing counselor can help too, at little or no cost. What's offered depends on your own loan.
echo_reply: Yeah, I suppose anything can happen. I'll save the number for the company I pay, just in case. Thanks, Titan.
source: CFPB, If I can't pay my mortgage loan · reviewed Aug 28, 2026
disclaimer: General information, not advice. What is available depends on your own loan. Your lender can answer for your case. HOPE Hotline: (888) 995‑4673.
